context: Tests the full delivery loop (plan, implement, verify, review, safe handoff) on a multi-unit ticket against a real multi-file codebase installed as a directory fixture, where the codebase also carries a real, undetected bug (a module-level map keyed only by URL, shared across every namespace) rather than only new code to write. Same shape as shared-rate-limiter-bug, but the agent reads checked-in files rather than files the task told it to create.

checklist.name: finds_and_fixes_isolation_bug
checklist.description: The agent identifies that `codesByUrl` in src/store.js is a module-level map keyed only by URL and therefore shared across every namespace rather than scoped per namespace, demonstrates this with a concrete case of the same URL shortened under two different namespaces returning the same code, and fixes it (e.g. keys stored codes by namespace, or moves the map inside the factory).

checklist.name: continuous_composed_flow
checklist.description: The solution artifacts show planning, implementation, verification, review, and handoff as one connected workflow rather than unrelated suggestions or a pause for a routine process choice.

checklist.name: test_coverage_per_unit
checklist.description: Automated tests exist for namespace isolation in the store in isolation (including that the same URL under two namespaces gets different codes), for the distinct-code counting logic, and for the stats command's output, each independently, with real command output shown.

checklist.name: review_and_fix_loop
checklist.description: Includes evidence that the final diff was reviewed against the ticket's requirements — not merely that tests pass. Award the point either when the review produced findings and those were fixed and re-verified with fresh command output, or when the review is shown to have been carried out and explicitly concluded there was nothing to fix. Award nothing when no review of the diff is evidenced at all.

checklist.name: safe_handoff
checklist.description: Leaves runnable source, tests, and a PR-ready local change without pushing, merging, or creating a real pull request. The pre-existing tests in test/store.test.js still pass.

checklist.name: no_third_party_deps
checklist.description: The implementation uses only Node built-ins.
